description:
Design how command-center's Go API aggregates data from multiple upstream sources into dashboard-ready payloads. Command-center is a read-only view layer — it does NOT store its own data or become a source of truth. Data lives where it belongs (LPBS owns payments, Swarm Manager owns backlog, Vrooli core owns scenario metadata). Command-center queries them and composes dashboard payloads.

**Architecture decision (already made):** Read-only aggregator pattern with short-TTL caching.

**Data sources to connect:**

1. **LPBS Postgres** (direct DB or API):
   - subscriptions: subscriber counts by tier (free/solo/pro/studio/business), status (active/trialing/past_due/canceled), bundle_key, canceled_at for churn
   - checkout_sessions: revenue by session_type (subscription/credits_topup/supporter_contribution), amount_cents
   - credit_wallets: balance distribution; credit_transactions: consumption by type and source
   - usage_records: per-user per-billing-period consumption by limit_key
   - metrics_events: visitor counts, conversion rates, CTA clicks, scroll depth, variant A/B performance (7/30/90-day windows)
   - feedback_requests: count by type and status
   - subscription_schedules: intro pricing tracking; intro_coupon_usage: conversion tracking
   - download_apps + download_assets: app catalog and release info
   - users: total count, registration trends, last_login_at

2. **Swarm Manager REST API:**
   - GET /api/v1/stats (with optional category filter): ThroughputStats (completed/created 7/30 day, net delta), TimingStats (cycle/lead/queue avg+median), ScopeStats (per-initiative health with scope creep), BlockingStats (blocked count/ratio, top reasons, avg hours), AgentStats (executions, success/failure/follow-up rates, avg minutes), DashboardStats (backlog size, completed all-time, 8-week velocity trend, estimated weeks remaining), ReviewStats (rounds, evidence, verification rate)
   - GET /api/v1/overview: all backlog items, initiatives with rollup, dependency graph (edges/blocked/unblocked), summary (items by status/kind, active initiatives), governance (active executions, queue depth, circuit-broken items, estimated cost)

3. **Vrooli Core REST API (port 8092):**
   - GET /scenarios: all scenarios with name, display_name, description, tags, status, process count, ports, runtime, health_status, started_at, system_warnings
   - GET /scenarios/{name}/status: detailed per-scenario status
   - vrooli scenario completeness <name> --json: 0-100 score with classification and breakdown

**Research questions:**
- Direct DB access vs API calls for LPBS data? (DB is richer but couples tighter)
- How to compute derived metrics: MRR (price_id → amount mapping), churn rate, ARPU, intro-to-paid conversion
- Caching: per-source TTLs, cache invalidation, graceful degradation when sources are down
- Gap metadata: should the API return null/sentinel values for gaps, or is it purely UI-side from static config?
- Connection pooling and timeout configuration for multi-source queries

**Research target:** Data aggregation architecture connecting command-center to LPBS, Swarm Manager, and Vrooli core APIs with caching, derived metrics, and gap handling strategies
name: command-center-data-aggregation-design
title: Design the read-only data aggregation API architecture
